author: Whatfinger
title: Wadephul: "German soldiers will defend every centimeter" of NATO territory | DW News
text:
German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has told DW that security in Europe is possible only "in opposition to Russia." He was speaking in an exclusive interview with DW and the Polish broadcaster TVP on the sidelines of the German-Polish Forum in Berlin.
#germany #poland #ukraine #russia #wadephul
00:00 Johann Wadephul, German Foreign Minister, on the German-Polish Forum
01:20 Future of German-Polish relations
02:41 German-Polish defence agreement
04:37 Wadephul on the Bundestag: "The vast majority is in favor of supporting Ukraine."
07:18 Wadephul: Diplomacy can still be relevant regarding Russia—but without illusions
